svg.text: POD SIDE VIEW (left pod, cover off)
· module 1.5, 32 teeth, 20° pressure angle, 8 wide, PLA at 100 % infill
· pitch Ø 48 · tip Ø 51 · root Ø 44.25 · centre distance 48
· 1 : 1 : 1 with an odd count: front and rear tyres turn the same way at the same speed
· drive gear + coupler = one printed part (D-bore on the 6 mm shaft, M3 grub screw)
· driven gear + rear hub = one part, spinning on the v4 sleeve + M3 bolt axle
· idler on an M3 × 25 shoulder bolt through the pod wall; its hole is a 0.6 mm slot to set backlash
· lowest tooth 7.5 off the mat, inside the closed pod floor (z 5)
· tyre ↔ wing: ≥ 3.5 over the tread, 7 to the inside of the wing wall
· gear ↔ pod cover 1 · gear ↔ pod wall 3.5 · cover ↔ tyre 2
· motor terminals meet at x 0 ± 3; motors drop in from above before the bridge goes on
· pods are closed: no tooth can be reached from outside (wing skirt + cover + floor)
· every gear is the same part shape, so one spare covers any of the six
sumo v5 · chassis schematics · rev A · 2026-11-14
two motors, four driven tyres: a three-gear train in each wing pod
mm · x right, y forward, z up · mat at z 0 · for review, not for print
